- **"Your subscription box left Bristol this morning."**: Consistent with the Bristol packing/operations facts. A transactional shipping statement, not a marketing claim. Fine.

- **"If you're away next month, you can pause or cancel any time from your account."**: Matches the approved claim "Subscribers can pause or cancel any time". Fine.

- Not an ad placement or affiliate content, so no label is needed.
- Voice: warm, plain, unhurried. No banned words or AI clichés. UK spelling is consistent.
